title: 第12课 · 把重要的东西放在我这儿吧
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 12 — 把重要的东西放在我这儿吧 · Leave the important items with me

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在家 — At home

items.zh: 太阳
items.py: tàiyáng
items.en: sun

items.zh: 西
items.py: xī
items.en: west

items.zh: 生气
items.py: shēng qì
items.en: angry

items.zh: 小丽：今天太阳从西边出来了吗？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Jīntiān tàiyáng cóng xībian chūlai le ma?
items.en: Xiaoli: Did the sun rise in the west today?

items.zh: 小刚：怎么了？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Zěnme le?
items.en: Xiaogang: What do you mean?

items.zh: 小丽：你怎么这么早就要睡觉了？以前都要12点以后才睡觉。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ zěnme zhème zǎo jiù yào shuì jiào le? Yǐqián dōu yào shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu cái shuì jiào.
items.en: Xiaoli: Why are you going to bed so early? You never used to go to bed until after twelve.

items.zh: 小刚：我明天8点就要到公司。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒ míngtiān bā diǎn jiù yào dào gōngsī.
items.en: Xiaogang: I have to be at the company by eight tomorrow.

items.zh: 小丽：有事吗？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Yǒu shì ma?
items.en: Xiaoli: Is something up?

items.zh: 小刚：经理生气了，他告诉我，明天8点不到，以后就别来了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Jīnglǐ shēng qì le, tā gàosu wǒ, míngtiān bā diǎn bù dào, yǐhòu jiù bié lái le.
items.en: Xiaogang: The manager is angry. He told me that if I'm not there by eight tomorrow, I needn't come back.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在家 — At home

items.zh: 行李箱
items.py: xínglixiāng
items.en: luggage, suitcase

items.zh: 自己
items.py: zìjǐ
items.en: self

items.zh: 包
items.py: bāo
items.en: bag, sack

items.zh: 小刚：我要跟周经理去外地办事，明天的飞机。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒ yào gēn Zhōu jīnglǐ qù wàidì bàn shì, míngtiān de fēijī.
items.en: Xiaogang: I'm going on a business trip with Manager Zhou; the flight is tomorrow.

items.zh: 小丽：那我帮你把衣服放到行李箱里吧。什么时候回来？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nà wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ yīfu fàngdào xínglixiāng li ba. Shénme shíhou huílai?
items.en: Xiaoli: Then let me help you put your clothes in the suitcase. When will you be back?

items.zh: 小刚：一个星期就回来。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Yī ge xīngqī jiù huílai.
items.en: Xiaogang: I'll be back in just a week.

items.zh: 小丽：啊？一个星期以后才回来？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Á? Yī ge xīngqī yǐhòu cái huílai?
items.en: Xiaoli: What? You won't be back for a whole week?

items.zh: 小刚：你要自己照顾好自己，我已经给你准备好吃的和喝的了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nǐ yào zìjǐ zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ, wǒ yǐjīng gěi nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo chī de hé hē de le.
items.en: Xiaogang: Take good care of yourself. I've already got food and drinks ready for you.

items.zh: 小丽：好吧。我已经把我的照片放在你的包里了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Hǎo ba. Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ wǒ de zhàopiàn fàng zài nǐ de bāo li le.
items.en: Xiaoli: All right. I've already put my photo in your bag.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在机场 — At the airport

items.zh: 发现
items.py: fāxiàn
items.en: to discover

items.zh: 护照
items.py: hùzhào
items.en: passport

items.zh: 起飞
items.py: qǐfēi
items.en: (of an aircraft) to take off

items.zh: 司机
items.py: sījī
items.en: driver

items.zh: 周明：你怎么才来？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Nǐ zěnme cái lái?
items.en: Zhou Ming: Why are you only getting here now?

items.zh: 小刚：对不起，周经理，来机场的路上我才发现忘带护照了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Duìbuqǐ, Zhōu jīnglǐ, lái jīchǎng de lùshang wǒ cái fāxiàn wàng dài hùzhào le.
items.en: Xiaogang: Sorry, Manager Zhou. Only on the way to the airport did I realise I'd forgotten my passport.

items.zh: 周明：快点吧，飞机就要起飞了。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Kuài diǎn ba, fēijī jiù yào qǐfēi le.
items.en: Zhou Ming: Hurry up, the plane is about to take off.

items.zh: 小刚：您有钱吗？司机把我送到机场的时候，我才发现忘记带钱包了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nín yǒu qián ma? Sījī bǎ wǒ sòngdào jīchǎng de shíhou, wǒ cái fāxiàn wàngjì dài qiánbāo le.
items.en: Xiaogang: Do you have any money? When the driver dropped me at the airport, I realised I'd forgotten my wallet.

items.zh: 周明：我看你还是把重要的东西放在我这儿吧。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Wǒ kàn nǐ háishi bǎ zhòngyào de dōngxi fàng zài wǒ zhèr ba.
items.en: Zhou Ming: I think you'd better leave the important things with me.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — A teacher's complaint

items.zh: 教
items.py: jiāo
items.en: to teach

items.zh: 画
items.py: huà
items.en: to draw, to paint; drawing, painting

items.zh: 需要
items.py: xūyào
items.en: to need

items.zh: 黑板
items.py: hēibǎn
items.en: blackboard

items.zh: 我是一个中学老师，教学生画画儿。
items.py: Wǒ shì yī ge zhōngxué lǎoshī, jiāo xuésheng huà huàr.
items.en: I'm a middle-school teacher; I teach students to draw.

items.zh: 每次下课前，我都会把下次学生需要带的东西写在黑板上，但是每次上课时，总会有学生忘了拿铅笔，所以我有点儿生气，不是因为他们没带铅笔，是因为他们没有好的学习习惯。
items.py: Měi cì xià kè qián, wǒ dōu huì bǎ xià cì xuésheng xūyào dài de dōngxi xiě zài hēibǎn shang, dànshì měi cì shàng kè shí, zǒng huì yǒu xuésheng wàngle ná qiānbǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ yǒudiǎnr shēng qì, bù shì yīnwèi tāmen méi dài qiānbǐ, shì yīnwèi tāmen méiyǒu hǎo de xuéxí xíguàn.
items.en: Before the end of every class I write on the blackboard what students need to bring next time, but every class some students still forget their pencils. So I'm a bit angry, not because they didn't bring pencils, but because they don't have good study habits.

items.zh: 我早上五点就起床了。
items.py: Wǒ zǎoshang wǔ diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le.
items.en: I got up as early as five in the morning.

items.zh: 坐飞机一个小时就到了。
items.py: Zuò fēijī yī ge xiǎoshí jiù dào le.
items.en: By plane you get there in just an hour.

items.zh: 我很容易就找到了他的家。
items.py: Wǒ hěn róngyì jiù zhǎodàole tā de jiā.
items.en: I found his home very easily.

items.zh: 你怎么这么早就要睡觉了？
items.py: Nǐ zěnme zhème zǎo jiù yào shuì jiào le?
items.en: Why are you going to bed so early?

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (才：晚、慢、不顺利)

items.zh: 八点上课，他九点才起床。
items.py: Bā diǎn shàng kè, tā jiǔ diǎn cái qǐ chuáng.
items.en: Class starts at eight, but he didn't get up until nine.

items.zh: 坐火车八个小时才能到。
items.py: Zuò huǒchē bā ge xiǎoshí cái néng dào.
items.en: By train it takes a whole eight hours to get there.

items.zh: 弟弟三个小时才做完作业。
items.py: Dìdi sān ge xiǎoshí cái zuòwán zuòyè.
items.en: It took my younger brother three hours to finish his homework.

items.zh: 来机场的路上我才发现忘带护照了。
items.py: Lái jīchǎng de lùshang wǒ cái fāxiàn wàng dài hùzhào le.
items.en: Only on the way to the airport did I realise I'd forgotten my passport.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (把字句2：A把B+V+在/到+地方)

items.zh: 我把照片放在你包里了。
items.py: Wǒ bǎ zhàopiàn fàng zài nǐ bāo li le.
items.en: I put the photo in your bag.

items.zh: 老师把作业放在桌子上了。
items.py: Lǎoshī bǎ zuòyè fàng zài zhuōzi shang le.
items.en: The teacher put the homework on the desk.

items.zh: 我没把裤子放到椅子上。
items.py: Wǒ méi bǎ kùzi fàngdào yǐzi shang.
items.en: I didn't put the trousers on the chair.

items.zh: 我帮你把衣服放到行李箱里吧。
items.py: Wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ yīfu fàngdào xínglixiāng li ba.
items.en: Let me help you put your clothes in the suitcase.

items.zh: 我把鲜花送给老师了。
items.py: Wǒ bǎ xiānhuā sònggěi lǎoshī le.
items.en: I gave the flowers to the teacher.

items.zh: 我朋友把书借给我了。
items.py: Wǒ péngyou bǎ shū jiègěi wǒ le.
items.en: My friend lent me the book.

items.zh: 弟弟没把钱还给哥哥。
items.py: Dìdi méi bǎ qián huángěi gēge.
items.en: My younger brother didn't pay the money back to our older brother.

items.zh: 你帮我把这本书带给小刚。
items.py: Nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ zhè běn shū dàigěi Xiǎogāng.
items.en: Please take this book to Xiaogang for me.
